title: vol2segavg
description: Computes the average of a volume inside a given segment of a segmentation resampling the input volume to the segmentation space.

output_file.description: Output file, can be .txt or a binary (e.g., .nii, .mgh)
output_file.title: Output file

registration.description: Registration file, can be reg.dat or use --regheader
registration.title: Registration file

subject_id.description: Subject ID, may be needed if --reg not supplied
subject_id.title: Subject ID

segmentation_id.description: Segmentation ID(s). Multiple IDs can be supplied.
segmentation_id.title: Segmentation ID

wm_flag.description: Sets segid to 2, 41, 7, 46, 251, 252, 253, 254, 255, 77, 78, 79 and use aparc+aseg
wm_flag.title: White matter flag

vcsf_flag.description: Sets segid to 4, 5, 43, 44, 31, 63 and use aparc+aseg
vcsf_flag.title: Ventral CSF flag

xcsf_flag.description: Sets segid to 257 and use apas+head
xcsf_flag.title: Extended CSF flag
